LanguageData.FOWAL_SeeDownDesc: Colonists reveal what they see through open air (or over a wall top) on the levels below.
LanguageData.FOWAL_SeeUpDesc: Colonists who see a cell with open sky above it also see the roof cells near that opening on the levels above.
LanguageData.FOWAL_UpDepthDesc: How far from an opening, on the level above, a colonist below can see.
